title: Python programming
text: Python is a programming language for scripts, automation, and data analysis. Python functions organize reusable code.

title: BM25 search ranking
text: BM25 ranks documents for keyword search. Ranking combines term frequency, inverse document frequency, and document length normalization.

title: Inverted indexes
text: An inverted index maps each term to documents containing that term. Search engines use indexes to find keyword matches quickly.

title: Sourdough bread
text: Sourdough bread uses flour, water, salt, and a starter. Fermentation develops flavor before baking bread in a hot oven.

title: Garden tomatoes
text: Tomatoes grow best with sunlight, water, and rich soil. Garden plants need regular watering and support as fruit grows.

title: Python text processing
text: Python scripts process text documents. Tokenization converts text into terms for keyword search and document ranking.

title: VPS SSH Security
text: SSH public keys secure access to a Linux VPS server. Password authentication can be disabled for stronger server security.

title: Linux Python Automation
text: Python scripts can automate Linux server administration and security checks.
